arxiv-1510-09093.title: Enabling Learning by Teaching: Intuitive Composing of E-Learning Modules
arxiv-1510-09093.creator: Alexander Berntsen Stian Ellingsen Emil Henry Flakk alexander@plaimi.net stian@plaimi.net emil@plaimi.net
arxiv-1510-09093.description: Abstract In an effort to foster learning by teaching, we propose the development of a canvas system that makes composing e-learning modules intuitive. We try to empower and liberate non-technical module users by lowering the bar for turning them into module authors, a bar previously set far too high. In turn, this stimulates learning through teaching.

arxiv-2206-02275.title: Sharper Rates and Flexible Framework for Nonconvex SGD with Client and Data Sampling Thanks: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology, Thuwal, Saudi Arabia
arxiv-2206-02275.creator: Alexander Tyurin, Lukang Sun, Konstantin Burlachenko, Peter Richtárik
arxiv-2206-02275.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Alexander Tyurin, Lukang Sun, Konstantin Burlachenko, Peter Richtárik. We revisit the classical problem of finding an approximately stationary point of the average of n n smooth and possibly nonconvex functions. The optimal complexity of stochastic first-order methods in terms of the number of gradient evaluations of individual functions is 𝒪 ⁡ ( n + n 1 / 2 ​ ε − 1 ) \mathcal{O}\left(n+n^{1/2}\varepsilon^{-1}\right) , attained by the optimal SGD methods SPIDER ( Fang et al., 2018 ) and PAGE ( Li et al.,

arxiv-2209-12170.title: Chiral cavity induced spin selectivity
arxiv-2209-12170.creator: Nguyen Thanh Phuc
arxiv-2209-12170.description: Abstract Chiral-induced spin selectivity (CISS) is a phenomenon in which electron spins are polarized as they are transported through chiral molecules, and the spin polarization depends on the handedness of the chiral molecule. In this study, we show that spin selectivity can be realized in achiral materials by coupling electrons to a single mode of a chiral optical cavity.

arxiv-2209-13678.title: FAIR-FATE: Fair Federated Learning with Momentum
arxiv-2209-13678.creator: Teresa Salazar, Miguel Fernandes, Helder Araújo, Pedro Henriques Abreu
arxiv-2209-13678.description: Abstract While fairness-aware machine learning algorithms have been receiving increasing attention, the focus has been on centralized machine learning, leaving decentralized methods underexplored. Federated Learning is a decentralized form of machine learning where clients train local models with a server aggregating them to obtain a shared global model.

arxiv-2304-11917.title: Generalized Cartesian Symmetry Classes Thanks: ∗ Corresponding author
arxiv-2304-11917.creator: Seyyed Sadegh Gholami and Yousef Zamani ∗
arxiv-2304-11917.description: Abstract . Let V V be a unitary space. Suppose G G is a subgroup of the full symmetric group S m S_{m} and 𝔛 \mathfrak{X} is an irreducible unitary representation of G G . In this paper, we introduce the generalized Cartesian symmetry class over V V associated with G G and 𝔛 \mathfrak{X} .

arxiv-2306-17399.title: Japanese Lexical Complexity for Non-Native Readers: A New Dataset
arxiv-2306-17399.creator: Yusuke Ide Masato Mita Adam Nohejl Hiroki Ouchi Taro Watanabe
arxiv-2306-17399.description: Abstract Lexical complexity prediction (LCP) is the task of predicting the complexity of words in a text on a continuous scale. It plays a vital role in simplifying or annotating complex words to assist readers. To study lexical complexity in Japanese, we construct the first Japanese LCP dataset.

arxiv-2401-13661.title: Dévissage for generation in derived categories
arxiv-2401-13661.creator: Souvik Dey, Pat Lank
arxiv-2401-13661.description: Abstract . This note is concerned with generation in the derived category of bounded complexes with coherent cohomology over a Noetherian scheme. We demonstrate a flavor of ‘dévissage’ by identifying two explicit collections of structure sheaves for closed subschemes that classically generate the bounded derived category.

arxiv-2405-01778.title: Hierarchical mixture of discriminative Generalized Dirichlet classifiers
arxiv-2405-01778.creator: Elvis Togban, Djemel Ziou
arxiv-2405-01778.description: Abstract This paper presents a discriminative classifier for compositional data. This classifier is based on the posterior distribution of the Generalized Dirichlet which is the discriminative counterpart of Generalized Dirichlet mixture model. Moreover, following the mixture of experts paradigm, we proposed a hierarchical mixture of this classifier.

arxiv-2409-11289.title: The Spectro-Polarimeter (SP) of the Andrei B. Severny Solar Tower Telescope (STT) at the Crimean Astrophysical Observatory : Optical Design and Implementation
arxiv-2409-11289.creator: A.S.Alexander Kutsenko, V.Yu.Valery Terebizh, A.V.Andrei Dolgopolov, V.I.Valentina Abramenko, A.A.Andrei Plotnikov, D.G.Dmitriy Semyonov, V.N.Vladimir Skiruta, V.I.Vyacheslav Lopukhin
arxiv-2409-11289.description: Abstract The Spectro-Polarimeter (SP) is a new instrument installed at the upgraded Andrei B. Severny Solar Tower Telescope (STT) at the Crimean Astrophysical Observatory . The instrument is a traditional echelle slit dual-beam spectropolarimeter with temporal modulation of the polarization.

arxiv-2503-17727.title: The Large Hadron electron Collider as a bridge project for CERN
arxiv-2503-17727.creator: F. Ahmadova, K. André, N. Armesto, G. Azuelos, O. Behnke, M. Boonekamp, M. Bonvini, D. Britzger, O. Brüning, T.A. Bud, A.M. Cooper-Sarkar, J. D’Hondt, M. D’Onofrio, O. Fischer, L. Forthomme, F. Giuli, C. Gwenlan, E. Hammou, B. Holzer, H. Khanpour, U. Klein, P. Kostka, T. Lappi, H. Mäntysaari, B. Mel
arxiv-2503-17727.description: Abstract Abstract The LHeC is the project for delivering electron-nucleon collisions at CERN using the HL-LHC beams. An Energy Recovery Linac in racetrack configuration will provide 50 GeV electrons to achieve centre-of-mass energies around 1 TeV/nucleon and instantaneous luminosities around 10 34 10^{34} cm -2 s -1 .

arxiv-2507-06794.title: Revealing the Hidden Temporal Structure of HubertSoft Embeddings based on the Russian Phonetic Corpus Thanks: Corresponding author
arxiv-2507-06794.creator: Anastasia Ananeva, Anton Tomilov, Marina Volkova
arxiv-2507-06794.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anastasia Ananeva, Anton Tomilov, Marina Volkova. Self-supervised learning (SSL) models such as Wav2Vec 2.0 and HuBERT have shown remarkable success in extracting phonetic information from raw audio without labelled data. While prior work has demonstrated that SSL embeddings encode phonetic features at the frame level, it remains unclear whether these models preserve temporal structure, specifically, whether embeddings at phoneme boundaries reflect the identity and order of adjacent phonemes.

arxiv-2510-08745.title: Intelligent backpropagated neural networks application on Couette-Poiseuille flow of variable viscosity in a composite porous channel filled with an anisotropic porous layer
arxiv-2510-08745.creator: Timir Karmakar, Amrita Mandal
arxiv-2510-08745.description: Abstract This study examines Couette-Poiseuille flow of variable viscosity within a channel that is partially filled with a porous medium. To enhance its practical relevance, we assume that the porous medium is anisotropic with permeability varying in all directions, making it a positive semidefinite matrix in the momentum equation.

A total of 109 micro-dissected PDA cases were subjected to whole-exome sequencing. Microdissection enriches tumour cellularity and enhances

pmc-10552215.title: Recurrence hyperparathyroidism caused by synchronous parathyroid carcinoma and parathyromatosis in a patient with long-term hemodialysis
pmc-10552215.creator: Jun Yang, Xili Lu, Pingping Zhou, Hao Liu, Jili Wang, Xinhui Su
pmc-10552215.description: BackgroundParathyroid carcinoma and parathyromatosis are very rare diseases in patients on hemodialysis. Its pathogenesis, clinical features, preoperative diagnosis, and surgery are challenging. We describe a rare case of recurrent hyperparathyroidism due to synchronous parathyroid carcinoma and parathyromatosis.Case presentationA 46-year-old Chinese woman was diagnosed with end-stage renal disease and received regular hemodialysis.

pmc-10598244.title: Survival and predictors of mortality among acute leukemia patients on follow‐up in Tikur Anbessa Specialized Hospital, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia: A 5‐year retrospective cohort study
pmc-10598244.creator: Bargude Balta, Tigistu Gebreyohannis, Erdaw Tachbele
pmc-10598244.description: BackgroundAlthough Ethiopia has more than 78% of leukemia cases and a significant burden of the disease, the survival of leukemia patients in the country is poorly recognized. The purpose of this study was to assess the survival and predictors of acute leukemia patients.

pmc-10735434.title: CHANGES IN ACCELEROMETER MEASURED MOVEMENT BEHAVIORS OVER RETIREMENT: A COMPOSITIONAL DATA APPROACH
pmc-10735434.creator: Lawrence Sacco, Hugo Westerlund
pmc-10735434.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Retirement is a significant life transition where individuals change their daily patterns of movement behaviors (i.e. physical activity and sedentary behavior). However, evidence accounting for how individuals re-allocate time from one type of activity to another is lacking, considering that engagement in different activities is co-dependent as time not spent in a given type of activity will be spent in another one.

pmc-11503605.title: An 8‐year observational study of the death places of patients with COPD in Turkey
pmc-11503605.creator: Aytekin İdikut, Maide Gözde İnam, Damla Karadeniz Güven, Serdar Ceylan, Oğuz Karcioğlu
pmc-11503605.description: AimThe place of death is one of the indicators of the quality of end‐of‐life care, which has become an essential public health issue with the aging of the population and the increase in life expectancy. There is a lack of data regarding the location of deaths caused by chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), the third‐leading cause of mortality worldwide.

pmc-11550281.title: Efficacy and Safety of Advanced Therapies in Moderately-to-Severely Active Ulcerative Colitis: a Systematic Review and Network Meta-analysis
pmc-11550281.creator: Axel Dignass, Claire Ainsworth, Susanne Hartz, Niels Dunnewind, Isabel Redondo, Christophe Sapin, Sonja Kroep, Nicholas Halfpenny, Emanuele Arcà, Sami Hoque
pmc-11550281.description: IntroductionThis study aimed to compare the efficacy and safety of biologics and small molecules for treatment of adults with moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis (UC).MethodsA systematic literature review was conducted to identify randomised controlled trials evaluating approved and emerging targeted therapies for patients with UC. A Bayesian network meta-analysis (NMA) approach was applied.

pmc-11632947.title: Lipid-lowering agent preferences among patients with hypercholesterolemia: a focus group study
pmc-11632947.creator: Hei Hang Edmund Yiu, Kehui Deng, Lydia WY Fung, Xuxiao Ye, Joseph Edgar Blais, Hung Fat Tse, Martin Chi Sang Wong, Bryan P Yan, William Chi Wai Wong, Xue Li, Carlos King Ho Wong, Chun Ka Wong, Esther W Chan
pmc-11632947.description: BackgroundNon-adherence to lipid-lowering agents poses significant risks to patients and diminishes treatment effectiveness. Current understanding of patients’ preferences regarding the characteristics of these agents is limited. This study aims to qualitatively identify the barriers to lipid-lowering medication adherence and the factors considered by patients with hypercholesterolemia when choosing lipid-lowering agents, and to inform the design of a medication preference study.

pmc-11713321.title: Studying the prevalence of ApoE Haplotypes in the Caribbean Hispanics from Puerto Rico
pmc-11713321.creator: Frances M Marin Maldonado, Cristal Garcia Blondet, Ana S Duconge, Jessica Renta, Jose Colon Saez, Jorge Duconge Soler
pmc-11713321.description: BackgroundAmong different ethnic groups, Hispanics rank second in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) prevalence. However, most studies on this condition have been conducted in Europeans. To address this bias in representation we interviewed and collected samples from Caribbean Hispanics living in Puerto Rico; to ascertain the prevalence of ApoE haplotypes and measure their association with the development of AD in this population.

pmc-12404510.title: IUC24390-83 Morphology of circulating tumor cells: how it might relate to biology and clinics in prostate cancer
pmc-12404510.creator: R Wenta, J Richert, A Muchlinska, B Pieczynska-Uzieblo, K Miszewski, M Matuszewski, A J Zaczek, N Bednarz-Knoll
pmc-12404510.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to characterize measurable morphological features such as size, shape, presence of protrusions, and micronuclei in circulating tumor cells (CTCs) in prostate cancer (PCa) patients and assess their clinical relevance.MethodsPeripheral blood (PB) and tumor-draining vein blood (TDVB) samples were collected from 118 PCa patients at the Medical University of Gdańsk between 2018 and 2023.

pmc-12649133.title: The Effect of Academic Environment on Turnover Intention of High-Skilled Scientific and Technology Professionals: Empirical Evidence from China’s First-Class Universities
pmc-12649133.creator: Xiuliang Dai, Lijian Wang, Dan Chen, Xiaoyu Guo
pmc-12649133.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The study constructs a theoretical framework for how the academic environment and job satisfaction affect the turnover intention of high-skilled science and technology talents (STPs), based on academic ecology theory and job satisfaction theory. Conducting a quantitative analysis based on survey data collected from 482 national-level STP recipients across 14 first-class universities, the study integrates descriptive statistics, ANOVA, OLS regression, and bias-corrected bootstrap mediation analysis to examine the relationships between these variables.

pmc-13077100.title: Liquid-liquid phase separation and its regulation of the BACH2 intrinsically disordered region
pmc-13077100.creator: Hironori Hayashi, Miyuki Kato-Murayama, Takeshi Kurasawa, Eiichi N. Kodama, Mikako Shirouzu, Kazuhiko Igarashi, Kazutaka Murayama
pmc-13077100.description: Intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) are vital for several cellular processes. They play a significant role in liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). LLPS enhances reaction efficiency by locally concentrating proteins and nucleic acids. The BACH2 transcription factor contains such IDRs. Early observations hinted at the phase separation capabilities of BACH2. However, how BACH2-IDR directly participates in LLPS is not fully understood.

pmc-13438703.title: Designing clinical AI for patient-centered support beyond the visit: the PACT framework for health systems
pmc-13438703.creator: Saif Khairat, Charles Safran
pmc-13438703.description: Clinical AI has advanced rapidly for bounded in-visit tasks such as prediction, documentation, and message generation, yet many costly failures in care occur outside the encounter when follow-up, handoffs, and communication break down. We argue that the next challenge for clinical AI is not only better task performance, but better operational follow-through across the care journey.

pmc-13630510.title: Association between glycometabolic indicators and risk of early vascular aging and their predictive value
pmc-13630510.creator: Jinjin Wang, Yujiao Yang, Ruoling Teng, Yi Ding, Fenfen Liu
pmc-13630510.description: BackgroundEarly vascular aging (EVA) elevates cardiovascular risk, and glycometabolic dysfunction is closely associated with arterial stiffness. Seven markers including TyG, CHG and HOMA-series indices were compared to explore their independent correlations and discriminative value for prevalent EVA among physical examinees.MethodsThis retrospective cross-sectional study enrolled 555 participants who underwent baPWV testing, identified from routine health-check records.

uslaw-usc-t54-s101101.title: 54 U.S.C. § 101101 — Authority to accept land, rights-of-way, buildings, other property, and money
uslaw-usc-t54-s101101.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t54-s101101.description: United States Code, Title 54 (National Park Service And Related Programs); Chapter 1011 (Donations); Subchapter I (Authority Of Secretary). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary in the administration of the Service may accept— (1) patented land, rights-of-way over patented land or other land, buildings, or other property within a System unit; and (2) money that may be donated for the purposes.
